Execute a bash script in a run's live session, at a moment.

The run must have a live session (it is in progress). The script executes on
a fresh branch of the multiverse, so it does not disturb the running test.
input_hash and vtime identify the moment to execute at. Give input_hash as a
string. A moment comes from the example and counterexample moments of the
runs_properties tool, or from the events of the runs_search tool. timeout is
the number of seconds the server waits for the script to exit (default 30).

Returns one JSON object per frame of the stream, one per line. An output
frame has moment, output_text and source.stream: "info" for the script's
standard output and "error" for its standard error. The last frame is the
result. It is {"status": "exited", "exit_code": ..., "end_moment": ...}, or
{"status": "timed_out", "last_moment": ...}. end_moment is the end of the
new branch, to execute a follow-up script from. A non-zero exit code, a
timeout, or a stream with no result frame marks the result isError, after
all the frames.
